complete_examples.text: Firstly, three damage categories are defined and five damage degrees are equivalently represented by modifying the stiffness and damping coefficients of target fasteners.
Finally, a fastener damage detection network is designed based on the FCN architecture to predict damage degrees by inputting the ABA, the track irregularity and the vehicle speed simultaneously.
